summary: Targeting and fire-rate only. What the shot actually does is a separate component.
overview: On a fire-rate timer it finds the closest enemy in range and hands it to whichever IAttackBehavior sits on the same GameObject. This component never executes an attack — that split is how one tower prefab picks hitscan or projectile by which component you add.
useCases: Any tower, with the attack style chosen by composition.
Retuning range and rate without touching attack code.
Adding a new attack style by writing one behaviour.

params.tuning: Used by the OverlapSphere. A wide mask makes every tower test every collider in range on every shot.
Shots per second, not seconds between shots — so higher is faster.
Also the OverlapSphere radius, so it is both a balance number and a performance one.

gotchas.title: A tower with no attack behaviour targets and never fires
gotchas.body: Nothing errors — it just silently does nothing. That is the first thing to check on a dead tower.

gotchas.title: Closest, not most dangerous
gotchas.body: Targeting is nearest-first with no priority options. Anything smarter means replacing the targeting, not configuring it.
